capabilities: Intercepts core and plugin UI text across four channels
Translates text through five configurable providers
Caches translations locally per language and model
Tracks token usage and cost in the status bar
Translates marketplace entries and READMEs on demand
disambiguation: Not a note-content translator; it only rewrites Obsidian core and plugin UI text, never notes, file names, or search results.
extras: Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly); never translates note content; no telemetry; API keys encrypted via Electron safeStorage; detailed beginner guide in docs/使用说明.md.
problem: Obsidian's community ecosystem is mostly English-only, and UI localization depends on each plugin author, leaving users waiting for translations.

relations.evidence: Google Cloud Translation | API key; broadest language coverage
Azure Translator | Key + region; 2M chars/month free

requires.name: translation API key (OpenAI-compatible, DeepL, Google Cloud, or Azure)
Ollama or LM Studio (for free local translation)

summary: UI-text middleware that intercepts Obsidian core and plugin interface text, translates it through your chosen API, and writes it back with local caching.
